This suggests over-trading low-quality coin markets rather than a universal strategy problem. ARB setups are small-sample but excellent (92% win, +$5.89 over 13 trades) and underutilized. The current live state shows the bot correctly skipping move10-20 setups repeatedly, which is good risk discipline, but it's still entering trades with 0/1 or low peer-agreement and conf just above the 0.57-0.67 range in regimes already flagged as thin-edge. Exits show heavy use of stop_loss at low bid levels (0.19-0.25) suggesting stops are triggering after moves have already mostly reversed, indicating momentum entries are frequently fading rather than continuing — classic mean-reversion regime in these 5-min windows, not trending.
